intro.text: A tall tree of Jah Keved that absorbs crem into its wood, giving it a light brown, rocklike texture and very strong branches.

description.text: Its long, needle-thin leaves are bright yellow, red, pink and orange, like bursts of flame, and pull back to shelter from highstorms.
Jella trees grow thickly on the slopes of basins partly sheltered from the highstorms.
They are strong enough to bear big canopies at outdoor festivals, though they can be cut down if needed. Their branches can bear a person's weight.
